:::{.definition data-title="Group"}

A **group** is a set $G$ with a [[binary-operation|binary operation]] $*$ such
that the following conditions are satisfied:
1. $*$ is associative;
2. $*$ has an identity; and
3. Every element of $G$ has an inverse.

:::

^b25159

We say that $G$ is a group "under" or "with respect to" the binary operation
$*$.

A group whose binary operation is commutative is called **commutative** or
**abelian**.

:::{.definition data-title="Order"}

We write $|S|$ for the number of elements of the (finite) set $S$; if $G$ is a
group, we call $|G|$ the group **order**.

:::
